description: Read-only. The user's scheduled social posts (from katto_publish_clip with schedule_at, or the dashboard calendar), newest first: { scheduled_posts: [{ id, job_id, clip_index, platform, scheduled_at, status, title, error, posted_at, created_at }], next_cursor }. status: pending = waiting for its time, posting = being published, posted = done, failed = see error. Paginate with cursor = the previous next_cursor; optional status filter.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response's next_cursor for the next page.

limit.description: How many posts to return (1-100, default 20).

status.description: Optional filter: pending (waiting for its time), posting, posted, failed.

name: katto_list_scheduled_posts
